description: C50 — 每个棋子都有任务吗？

intro.popup_en: Piece Coordination, Lesson 1: After developing a piece, ask what its job is. Pieces are coordinated when they work toward a shared plan.
intro.popup:
子力协调第1课
出子之后要问自己：这个棋子的任务是什么？
所有棋子服务于同一计划，才叫协调

outro.popup_en: Development is only the beginning; coordination is the goal. After each move, ask what the piece is contributing to the plan.
outro.popup:
总结：出子只是开始，协调才是目标
每步走完，问：这个棋子在干什么？

moves.popup_en: e4 occupies the center and opens the d- and e-files, preparing to develop Nf3 and Bc4.
moves.popup:
e4占领中心
激活：开放e和d列
计划：为Bc4+Nf3铺路

moves.popup_en: ...e5 also occupies the center.
moves.popup:
e5对称
黑方也占领中心

moves.popup_en: Nf3! White develops the first minor piece, controlling e5 and d4 while clearing the way for Bc4. Develop minor pieces before major pieces.
moves.popup:
Nf3！第1个轻子出动
激活：马控e5和d4
协调：为Bc4象的斜线清路
计划：轻子首先，重子最后

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops and protects e5.
moves.popup:
Nc6出动
黑方保护e5兵

moves.popup_en: Bc4! White's second minor piece targets f7. Together, Nf3 and Bc4 coordinate pressure against that square in the Italian Game.
moves.popup:
Bc4！第2个轻子
激活：象瞄准f7
协调：Nf3+Bc4联合施压f7
计划：意大利开局体系

moves.popup_en: ...Bc5 mirrors White's development and targets f2.
moves.popup:
Bc5出动
黑方对称，瞄准f2

moves.popup_en: Nc3! White develops the third minor piece. Nf3 and Nc3 coordinate to control d5 and e4; White can now consider castling.
moves.popup:
Nc3！第3个轻子出动
激活：第2个马
协调：Nf3+Nc3联合，d5+e4全控
计划：3子全出，可以易位了！

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops and attacks e4.
moves.popup:
Nf6出动
黑方攻击e4，灵活

moves.popup_en: d3 stabilizes the center and prepares Be3 in the closed Italian setup.
moves.popup:
d3稳固中心
为Be3做准备
意大利封闭体系

moves.popup_en: ...d6 reinforces Black's center.
moves.popup:
d6防守
黑方加固中心

moves.popup_en: O-O! White castles and activates the rook on f1, preparing to bring it to e1.
moves.popup:
O-O易位！
激活：Rf1进入游戏
计划：易位后准备Re1激活车

moves.popup_en: ...O-O secures Black's king. Both sides enter the middlegame with their kings safe.
moves.popup:
O-O黑方易位
双方王安全，进入中盘

moves.popup_en: Be3! White develops the c1-bishop and supports d4. Together, the two knights and bishop coordinate around the center.
moves.popup:
Be3！象出动
激活：c1象激活
协调：Be3支援d4格，与Nf3/Nc3联动
计划：Be3+Nf3+Nc3三子协调控制中心

moves.popup_en: ...Bxe3 exchanges Black's bishop for White's bishop on e3.
moves.popup:
Bxe3黑方换象
黑方换掉白方Be3

moves.popup_en: fxe3 recaptures and opens the f-file. White can coordinate pressure along both the e- and f-files, with Rfe1 in mind.
moves.popup:
fxe3重新吃象
激活：f列半开放
协调：e列+f列联合压力
计划：Rfe1沿e列施压

moves.popup_en: ...Na5?! Black's knight goes to the edge, away from the main action, without a clear task.
moves.popup:
Na5黑方马冒进
⚠️ 马到边缘，脱离协调
黑方马在a5是边缘马，任务不明确

moves.popup_en: Bb3 retreats the bishop from attack while retaining control of d5 and f7.
moves.popup:
Bb3象后退
激活：象离开对方马的攻击
协调：Bb3仍控制d5和f7
计划：保留象的活力

moves.popup_en: ...Nxb3 exchanges Black's knight for White's bishop on b3.
moves.popup:
Nxb3黑方换象
黑方换掉白方b3象

moves.popup_en: axb3 recaptures, opens the a-file, and reinforces the center with the pawn on b3.
moves.popup:
axb3重新夺回
激活：a列半开放
协调：b3兵加固中心

moves.popup_en: ...Re8 activates Black's rook on the e-file.
moves.popup:
Re8黑方车激活
黑方车进入e列

moves.popup_en: Qd2 develops the queen and connects White's rooks, preparing to occupy open files. The queen coordinates the rooks rather than acting alone.
moves.popup:
Qd2后出动
激活：后联结双车
协调：Qd2连接Ra1+Rf1，准备双车进列
计划：后是联结者，不是独行侠

moves.popup_en: ...a6 reinforces Black's queenside and prevents Nb5.
moves.popup:
a6黑方巩固
防止白方Nb5

moves.popup_en: Rfe1! White activates the final piece. The rook, Nc3, and Nf3 coordinate around the e-file and center. Every piece now has a task; the position is fully coordinated.
moves.popup:
Rfe1！车进e列！
激活：最后一个子力进入游戏
协调：Re1+Nc3+Nf3三子控制e列和中心
计划：协调完整——每个子力都有任务！
✅ 这就是子力协调的完成状态
